column7: ActivateMFA, DisableMFA, and RegenerateMFARecoveryCodes returned the raw requireActorActive error when the acting account was suspended, leaking account state ("the acting account is not active") to the caller instead of the generic "invalid code or password" message. Anti-enumeration: a caller who knows only a username must not be able to distinguish "account suspended" from "wrong credential" by the error text. Fixed by mfaActiveGuardRefusal() which re-wraps a requireActorActive ErrPermissionDenied as markPermissionDenied(&reauthRejectedError{msg: "invalid code or password"}) — same text as the wrong-credential path, satisfies errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied) for transport 403 mapping, and satisfies errors.Is(err, ErrReauthRejected). Storage faults (ErrStorageReadUnavailable, not ErrPermissionDenied) propagate unchanged as 503. Proving test compares suspended-actor error text with active-account-wrong-credential text across all three functions; they must be identical.
